Where Learning Comes Alive! 

Our K1 children explored letters through a variety of fun and hands-on activities. They practised letter formation, made letters using playdough, matched pictures with their beginning letters, and enjoyed sand tracing to strengthen letter recognition and formation. They also participated in a letter search and colour activity, making learning letters interactive and enjoyable.

These activities helped develop letter recognition, phonemic awareness, fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and pre-writing skills while building confidence in identifying and forming letters.

🌈 Rainbow in a Jar Experiment! 🌈

Our K2 little scientists had a colourful and exciting learning experience with the Rainbow in a Jar experiment! 

Using liquids of different densities, the children carefully observed how the colours settled into separate layers instead of mixing together. They were amazed to see a beautiful rainbow appear inside the jar! 

Through this hands-on experiment, children explored the concepts of colours, density, observation, prediction, and scientific thinking in a fun and engaging way.

A colourful experiment filled with curiosity, wonder, and joyful learning!

📮 See how letters are posted and sorted

📬 Learn how letters are dispatched to different areas

The smiles, excitement and endless questions made this field trip truly unforgettable. 

Here’s to learning through real experiences, curious minds and little adventures!
